Golden HTML editions built by the server's `html_edition` code on Fedora (TeX Live 2026,
make4ht v0.4e, MathJax 4.1.3), 2026-10-26: `synthetic-latex` and `synthetic-markdown` from the
documents of `tests/test_html_edition.py` (`configure_project`), `thoughts_manual` from the
template project. Each directory holds the edition files and its `manifest.json`
(`pdf_sha256` is a placeholder). For viewer tests (clients/html-viewer) and as references.
In `thoughts_manual`, three phrases and the project names in its two screenshots were replaced
with neutral ones after the build; its asset names and `manifest.json` hashes follow the new files.
